title: BiggoBlocks Large Building Blocks for Kids Ages 3-8 – 288 Piece Mega Set – Indoor & Outdoor STEM Toy for Boys & Girls
features: Mega Creativity Unleashed: With 288 jumbo-sized building blocks in 6 bold colors, this set empowers kids to build massive structures — from life-size forts to obstacle courses — sparking imagination on a grand scale.
Built for Group Play: Designed for classrooms, birthday parties, homeschooling pods, and big families, this set encourages collaborative building and social skill development in kids ages 3 and up.
Easy for Small Hands: Biggo Blocks are lightweight, smooth-edged, and perfectly sized for toddlers and kids, promoting confidence and independence in young builders.

STEM Learning in Action: While constructing castles and spaceships, children naturally develop fine motor skills, spatial awareness, problem-solving, and early STEM foundations — all through hands-on play.
Indoor & Outdoor Friendly: Crafted from durable, weather-resistant plastic, these giant blocks hold up to backyard play, rainy day building, or classroom use without missing a beat.

Smart Storage Solutions: The blocks stack flat and nest together like bricks, allowing them to be stored in just 4 inches of space. Slide under a bed or repurpose into toy boxes or kid-sized furniture!
Active, Screen-Free Fun: Encourages movement, teamwork, and unplugged play that supports healthier development and meaningful interactions.
